name: LOLA
summary: A lightweight biped from TU Munich's Chair of Applied Mechanics, built to push fast, robust human-like walking. LOLA has 26 electrically actuated joints (including toe joints) in a stiff, low-inertia structure, and demonstrates real-time vision-based foothold planning while traversing uneven ground.
notable: Active toe joints for a more human push-off
Real-time perceptive foothold planning on rough terrain

sources.title: TU Munich Chair of Applied Mechanics — Humanoid Robot LOLA
